page.title: Protection Policies
page.subtitle: Tune how the Gateway turns a risk score into a decision for your organization.
page.readOnly: Your role has read-only access. Ask an Owner, Admin or Analyst to change these settings.

thresholds.title: Risk thresholds
thresholds.desc: A request's risk score (0–100) decides what happens to it.

challenges.title: Challenges
challenges.desc: Silent verification for visitors the Gateway is unsure about.
challenges.silentJsHint: Runs invisibly in the browser to filter simple bots.
challenges.challengeAllHint: Every first-time visitor gets one silent check, then a clearance.

ai.title: AI anomaly detection
ai.desc: Behavioral model that adds a signal to the risk score.
ai.useAiHint: When off, decisions rely on rules and reputation only.
ai.note: The AI score is only one signal. The final decision always comes from the risk engine and these thresholds.

rateLimiting.title: Rate limiting
rateLimiting.desc: Per-IP request limits. The soft limit slows traffic, the hard limit caps it.
rateLimiting.banOnHardHint: Ban the device when it exceeds the hard limit.

autoBans.title: Automatic bans
autoBans.desc: When repeat offenders are banned, and for how long.

capacity.title: Server capacity
capacity.desc: Used to warn you before an origin server is overwhelmed.

allowMaxScore.label: Allow up to
allowMaxScore.hint: Scores up to this value are allowed.

rateLimitMaxScore.label: Rate-limit up to
rateLimitMaxScore.hint: Scores up to this value are rate limited.

challengeMaxScore.label: Challenge up to
challengeMaxScore.hint: Above this value the request is blocked.

passTokenTtlMinutes.label: Clearance lifetime
passTokenTtlMinutes.hint: How long a visitor who passed the challenge stays cleared.

rateLimitRequests.label: Soft limit — requests
rateLimitRequests.hint: Requests allowed per IP inside the window.

rateLimitWindowSec.label: Soft limit — window
rateLimitWindowSec.hint: Window length for the soft limit.

maxRequestsPerIp.label: Hard limit — requests
maxRequestsPerIp.hint: Absolute maximum per IP inside the window.

maxRequestsWindowSec.label: Hard limit — window
maxRequestsWindowSec.hint: Window length for the hard limit.

maxServerRps.label: Server capacity override
maxServerRps.hint: Leave empty to use the capacity detected for each server.

capacityWarnPercent.label: Capacity warning at
capacityWarnPercent.hint: Notify when server load reaches this percentage.

autoBanAfterFails.label: Auto-ban after failures
autoBanAfterFails.hint: Failed advanced checks before a device is banned.

temporaryBanMinutes.label: Temporary ban length
temporaryBanMinutes.hint: Duration of an automatic temporary ban.

permanentBanScore.label: Permanent ban score
permanentBanScore.hint: Reputation score (1–10) that triggers a permanent ban.

validation.hardGeSoft: Hard limit rate must not be lower than the soft limit rate

bar.fixErrors: Fix the highlighted fields to save

toast.forbidden: You are not allowed to edit policies

resetModal.title: Reset all policies?
resetModal.description: Every setting returns to its default value. This applies immediately to the Gateway.
